The Revolutionary Socialist Party (Leninist) abbreviated as RSP(L) is a Communist political party in India. The leader of the party is Kovoor Kunjumon who is currently representing Kunnathoor assembly constituency in the Kerala Legislative Assembly. This party is an associate member of the LDF in the state of Kerala.
The party was formed in 2016 following a split from the Revolutionary Socialist Party under the leadership of Kovoor Kunjumon .
